messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for Wireless Communication without making unsupported claims?

**Formal R&S evidence for our signaling tester claims**: CMX500 claims should be traced to the CMX500 specifications document and the CMX500 Features and Functions document, because battle-card positioning is not a formal specification source [9].
CMX500 supported areas that can be cited include LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA/SA, FDD/TDD, WLAN signaling, WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, GUI, XLAPI and SCPI remote control [16].
**Exact CMX500 option evidence for signaling features**: WLAN signaling options such as CMX-KS350B through CMX-KS357B, CMX-KS360B and CMX-KS365B must be cited from the features/options table [57]; NR/LTE signaling options such as CMX-KS500B/M/X, CMX-KS600B/M/X, CMX-KS610B/M/X, CMX-KS612B/M/X and CMX-KS613B/X must also be cited from the same table [57]; RedCap, eRedCap and NTN signaling options must be cited from CMX-KS617B/M/X, CMX-KS618B/X, CMX-KS627B/M/X, CMX-KS628B/X and CMX-KS629B/X [60].
**Formal R&S evidence for non-signaling / production tester claims**: CMP180 production or wireless communication device testing claims can be cited because CMP180 is described as a Radio Communication Tester for production / wireless communication device testing, configurable with multiport RF generator/analyzer, communication-standard measurement options, waveform options and R&S VSE analysis capability [29].
CMP180 also has documented simultaneous receiver/transmitter testing and optional multiport RF generator/analyzer architecture [30][31].
CMP200 FR2 nonsignaling claims can be cited because CMP200 with CMPHEAD30/CMPHEAD50 is described as a 5G NR FR2 mmWave nonsignaling one-box test solution [36][38].
**Binding-specification caution for our side**: CMX500 product data is subject to conditions such as warm-up, environmental conditions, recommended calibration interval and internal adjustments; non-traceable specifications, typical data, nominal values and measured values are not guaranteed [19].
CMX500 Features and Functions is not a specifications datasheet, and data without tolerance limits is not binding [56][59].
CMP200 and CMW100 K06 likewise distinguish warranted specifications from non-traceable, typical, nominal or measured values, and data without tolerance limits is not binding [40][41].
**Competitor-side official or third-party evidence**: Keysight wireless testing / UXM claims in the current knowledge base come only from an R&S battle-card viewpoint and are not Keysight official data [49].
Amarisoft competitor limitations such as “no global footprint,” “remote-only support,” “no Wi-Fi signaling” and “no production/ATE testers” require Amarisoft official data or third-party confirmation [47].
For Anritsu, customer-facing competitor claims should be checked against Anritsu official data and third-party evidence, because the battle-card claims are mainly from R&S internal positioning [15].
**No unsupported sales-language claims**: “only platform,” “industry’s only,” “fully integrated,” “industry-leading,” “widest frequency range,” “lower TCO” and similar sales language should not be treated as verifiable technical specifications unless supported by formal datasheets, features documents, conformance reports, configuration tools or equivalent evidence [5][15].
**Evidence for certification / conformance claims**: Claims about PTCRB/GCF alignment, operator acceptance, validated NTN, conformance or pre-conformance require formal test package option codes, accreditation documents, conformance reports, validation reports or test-case lists; the existing battle-card comparison tables explicitly note such evidence is missing for several claims [3][5].

passages.text:
R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 核心 thesis
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），R&S 對 [[amarisoft]] 的核心定位是：[[R&S CMX500]] 與 R&S radio communication tester portfolio 提供 instrument-grade、validated、calibrated、可延伸至 production 的 5G testing path；[[amarisoft]] 則被描述為 COTS hardware + software-defined stack 的 functional testing solution。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 是否需要 calibrated [[FR2]] / [[mmWave]] testing？
2. 是否需要 global support、multi-year warranty 或 calibration services？
3. 是否需要 [[Operator Acceptance]]、[[Conformance Testing]] 或 pre-conformance？
4. 是否需要 validated / [[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] aligned test cases，而不只是 functional simulation？
5. 是否需要 non-signaling ATE 或 multi-port production test？
6. 是否需要 integrated [[Wi-Fi signaling]]（6/6E/7）？
7. 是否需要 factory line 的 non-signaling test capability？
8. 是否需要 3GPP RF pre-conformance 或 aligned test coverage？

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | amarisoft positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 公司與支援 | Global support、field engineering、calibration labs、service contracts、multi-year warranties | small French private company；remote-only support；no global footprint | [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 未引用第三方或 amarisoft 官方文件 |
| FR1 / FR2 | [[R&S CMX500]] covers FR1、FR2 up to 50 GHz / calibrated FR2 | external RRH for FR2，calibration 以問號標示 | “up to 50 GHz” 為 battle card 說法；正式規格需引用 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] |
| Wi-Fi signaling | [[R&S CMX500]] integrated Wi-Fi signaling，含 Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 | external AP/N3IWF 或 no Wi-Fi signaling | Wi-Fi feature 需回查 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] |
| Conformance / operator acceptance | PTCRB/GCF aligned RF、RRM、protocol、IMS、VoNR、throughput、CA、mobility tests | functional only；not accepted for operator certification | 來源未列 test package option code 或 accreditation 文件 |
| Validated NTN | validated NR-NTN RF / RRM / protocol testcases，來源括註 w/ Samsung | functional simulation only | 未列 Samsung validation report 或 test case list |
| Legacy RAT | [[R&S CMW500]] 支援 2G/3G continuity | no 2G/3G stack | CMW500 正式能力需引用 [[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]] |
| Production path | [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] production / ATE / non-signaling path | no non-signaling platform、no production scaling path | 各 production platform 規格需分別引用其正式 source pages |
| Load / flexibility | battle card 主張 R&S validated testing | excellent functional load testing、up to 1000 UEs、flexible for NB-IoT / LTE-M / RedCap / basic NTN | amarisoft 能力缺少版本與硬體條件 |

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › R&S offensive plays
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]：

- **One-Box FR1 + FR2 + Wi-Fi Signaling + Validated Testing**：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 integrated platform。
- **Migration Kit**：script conversion、Python / [[XLAPI]] mapping、on-site bring-up、trade-in program；來源未列交付細節或商務條件。
- **NTN & RedCap Acceleration**：強化 validated vs. simulated message。
- **O-RAN Upgrade Path**：R&S + [[VIAVI]] → ORU conformance / NES；來源未展開產品與規格。
- **Production Path (ATE)**：將 CMX validation scale 到 [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] production lines。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › Battle card 中的 R&S positioning
來源的 positioning statement 主張：

- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] delivers the industry’s only fully integrated platform for FR1、FR2、Wi-Fi、fading、IP throughput、RF analysis、NTN、RedCap and end-to-end signalling in one instrument。
- 來源說 [[Keysight]] spreads equivalent capabilities across multiple UXM models、add-on software and external tools。
- 來源說 R&S ensures long-term scalability、measurement accuracy and path from R&D to certification without hardware fragmentation。

使用限制：以上是 sales language；其中 only、industry’s only、fully integrated、long-term scalability、lower TCO 等敘述不能當作可驗證規格，需回查正式 datasheet、features document、conformance report 或配置工具。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 重點摘要
- 來源將 [[Keysight]] 描述為大型美國 test & measurement vendor，總部在 Santa Rosa, California, USA，員工數約 **16,800+**，在 semiconductor、aerospace / defense、cloud 與 wireless testing 具有強市場存在。
- 來源主張 [[Keysight]] mobile communications strategy 越來越 software-led 與 AI-driven，但 [[Keysight UXM]] portfolio 分散於多個 hardware SKUs：[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515B]]、[[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]]。
- 來源列出 [[Keysight]] portfolio 包含 UXM 5G Wireless Test Platforms、[[ProbSim]] channel emulators、[[Nemo]] field test tools、[[RaySim]] digital twin engine、[[Atlas]] AI-powered device test、C-V2X 與 cybersecurity tools。
- 來源把 R&S positioning 表述為：[[R&S CMX500]] 在 one instrument 中整合 [[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、[[Wi-Fi]]、[[Fading]]、IP throughput、RF analysis、[[NTN]]、[[RedCap]] 與 end-to-end signaling；而 Keysight 需分散於多個 UXM models、add-on software 與 external tools。
- 來源主張 [[R&S CMX500]] 的差異化包含 one-platform architecture、integrated fading + IP + application testing、unified software ecosystem（[[CMsquares]]、[[R&S CMsequencer]]、AI Script Assistant）、measurement leadership、FR3 / 6G path、cellular + Wi-Fi in one platform，以及 NTN / RedCap / operator certification leadership。
- 來源對 [[Keysight]] 的弱點敘述包含 hardware fragmentation、multi-tool workflow、advanced testing external dependencies、limited legacy、Wi-Fi only on selected models、FR3 / 6G roadmap relies on add-ons。
- 來源的 quick comparison table 將 R&S / CMX500 描述為 one platform：FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + fading + IP + NTN + LTE + RedCap；將 Keysight 描述為 multiple UXM SKUs + external tools。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 對 Keysight 的主要主張
| 主題 | 來源對 Keysight 的說法 | 限制 |
|---|---|---|
| Portfolio | UXM 5G Wireless Test Platforms E7515B/W/P/E/R、ProbSim、Nemo、RaySim、Atlas、C-V2X、cybersecurity tools | 未提供 Keysight 官方 datasheet 或版本 |
| Architecture | Multi-Box UXM approach；不同 UXM 有不同 NR bandwidth、RF ports、Rel-17 support、WLAN capability、IP throughput、FR2 readiness | 未列各 SKU 的完整規格條件 |
| Software model | Atlas + Channel Studio + RaySim + Nemo + WLAN tools + UXM-specific features；no unified automation environment | 這是 R&S battle card 觀點，需 Keysight 官方資料驗證 |
| Support model | tiered KeysightCare model：Assured、Enhanced、Application Software Support；optional warranty / calibration assurance plan | 未提供 KeysightCare 文件版次或服務條款 |
| Wi-Fi | Wi-Fi signaling only on selected models：E7515W、E7515P | 未提供 Keysight WLAN option / configuration 文件 |
| RedCap | E7515R is dedicated RedCap / IoT model | 未提供 E7515R 官方規格或 order data |
| FR3 / 6G | UXM-P bandwidth options + RaySim + future hardware / software；multi-component approach | future hardware / software 未標示日期、型號或 release status |

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › Keysight 相關
- [[Keysight]] — 本 battle card 的競品公司。
- [[Keysight UXM]] — 來源中的 UXM 5G Wireless Test Platforms 總稱。
- [[Keysight E7515P]] — 來源稱 high-end wideband / 5G platform with Wi-Fi as additional capability；quick table 稱 E7515P up to 15 GHz。
- [[Keysight E7515W]] — 來源稱 Wi-Fi 7 / connectivity platform。
- [[Keysight E7515B]] — 來源稱 standard / mid-tier 5G UXM。
- [[Keysight E7515E]] — 來源稱 value / mid-tier 5G UXM。
- [[Keysight E7515R]] — 來源稱 RedCap / IoT-only SKU。
- [[ProbSim]] — channel emulator；來源在 integrated vs external fading landmine 中列名。
- [[RaySim]] — digital twin / ray tracing engine；來源說 advanced fading、digital twin、FR3 / 6G scenarios 可能需要 RaySim。
- [[Channel Studio]] — channel modeling / fading 相關 external tool。
- [[Nemo]] — field test tools；來源列於 Keysight fragmented toolchain。
- [[Atlas]] — AI-powered device test / test management；來源列於 Keysight fragmented toolchain。
- [[KeysightCare]] — 來源說 Keysight support model 使用 tiered KeysightCare：Assured、Enhanced、Application Software Support，以及 optional warranty / calibration assurance plan。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 與既有知識的關係
- 與 [[R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft]]、[[R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu]] 同屬 2026-02-26 R&S battle card 類型來源；三者都應視為競品銷售定位，而不是正式規格來源。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 的正式規格仍需以 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]（Version 11.00，August 2025）與 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]（Version 32，CSW 9.20.0 and higher）追溯。
- 本來源提到 [[R&S CMW500]] covers all legacy + EN-DC；[[R&S CMW500]] 的正式資料需追溯 [[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]]。
- 本來源新增 [[Keysight]] 在 wireless device testing battle card 語境中的公司與 UXM portfolio 描述；既有 [[Keysight]] 頁主要來自高頻高速 PCB 測試圖像來源，兩者資料層次不同。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › Sales landmines

1. 是否需要 FR1 bandwidth beyond 400 MHz，例如 600–800 MHz per carrier for 5G-Advanced Rel-18 / Rel-19 testing？
2. 是否需要 FR1、FR2、FR3、WLAN 與 LTE 在 single instrument 中且不用 hardware swaps？
3. 是否需要 native fading with high-throughput IP testing？
4. 是否偏好 one unified software platform，而不是 four separate tools？

**Formal R&S evidence for our signaling tester claims**: CMX500 claims should be traced to the CMX500 specifications document and the CMX500 Features and Functions document, because battle-card positioning is not a formal specification source [9].
CMX500 supported areas that can be cited include LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA/SA, FDD/TDD, WLAN signaling, WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, GUI, XLAPI and SCPI remote control [16].
**Exact CMX500 option evidence for signaling features**: WLAN signaling options such as CMX-KS350B through CMX-KS357B, CMX-KS360B and CMX-KS365B must be cited from the features/options table [57]; NR/LTE signaling options such as CMX-KS500B/M/X, CMX-KS600B/M/X, CMX-KS610B/M/X, CMX-KS612B/M/X and CMX-KS613B/X must also be cited from the same table [57]; RedCap, eRedCap and NTN signaling options must be cited from CMX-KS617B/M/X, CMX-KS618B/X, CMX-KS627B/M/X, CMX-KS628B/X and CMX-KS629B/X [60].
**Formal R&S evidence for non-signaling / production tester claims**: CMP180 production or wireless communication device testing claims can be cited because CMP180 is described as a Radio Communication Tester for production / wireless communication device testing, configurable with multiport RF generator/analyzer, communication-standard measurement options, waveform options and R&S VSE analysis capability [29].
CMP180 also has documented simultaneous receiver/transmitter testing and optional multiport RF generator/analyzer architecture [30][31].
CMP200 FR2 nonsignaling claims can be cited because CMP200 with CMPHEAD30/CMPHEAD50 is described as a 5G NR FR2 mmWave nonsignaling one-box test solution [36][38].
**Binding-specification caution for our side**: CMX500 product data is subject to conditions such as warm-up, environmental conditions, recommended calibration interval and internal adjustments; non-traceable specifications, typical data, nominal values and measured values are not guaranteed [19].
CMX500 Features and Functions is not a specifications datasheet, and data without tolerance limits is not binding [56][59].
CMP200 and CMW100 K06 likewise distinguish warranted specifications from non-traceable, typical, nominal or measured values, and data without tolerance limits is not binding [40][41].
**Competitor-side official or third-party evidence**: Keysight wireless testing / UXM claims in the current knowledge base come only from an R&S battle-card viewpoint and are not Keysight official data [49].
Amarisoft competitor limitations such as “no global footprint,” “remote-only support,” “no Wi-Fi signaling” and “no production/ATE testers” require Amarisoft official data or third-party confirmation [47].
For Anritsu, customer-facing competitor claims should be checked against Anritsu official data and third-party evidence, because the battle-card claims are mainly from R&S internal positioning [15].
**No unsupported sales-language claims**: “only platform,” “industry’s only,” “fully integrated,” “industry-leading,” “widest frequency range,” “lower TCO” and similar sales language should not be treated as verifiable technical specifications unless supported by formal datasheets, features documents, conformance reports, configuration tools or equivalent evidence [5][15].
**Evidence for certification / conformance claims**: Claims about PTCRB/GCF alignment, operator acceptance, validated NTN, conformance or pre-conformance require formal test package option codes, accreditation documents, conformance reports, validation reports or test-case lists; the existing battle-card comparison tables explicitly note such evidence is missing for several claims [3][5].
